A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete 17-page document, including Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v4 reports original Pythia and Llama experiments, including SenD comparisons, timing measurements, downstream evaluations and ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–4 and the appendix ablations and training trajectories.

M1.justification: SEI identification, Sensitivity Dropout training and Efficient EigenScore computation are identical in Sections 3–4 and Algorithms 1–2.

E1.justification: Both versions retain identical dataset and task coverage, including HELM, MedHALT, LegalBench, CodeSearchNet, XSum, HaluEval, HellaSwag and MMLU.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: random embedding dropout in Figure 2, regular EigenScore in the efficiency comparisons, and normal training with and without RAG in Tables 2 and 4.

E3.justification: The model configurations, 20-checkpoint oscillation study, generation settings, continual-training procedures and evaluation metrics are specified identically in both versions.

E4.justification: The SEI analyses, EES scaling and trajectory checks, and dropout-rate and step-threshold ablations are unchanged, including Appendices A–C.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting is identical. Figure 1 retains standard-deviation shading, and Figures 11 and 12 retain their respective five-run and ten-run averaging statements.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted results in Tables 1–4 and Figures 1–13 match. For example, Table 2 retains Llama 8B FactScore values of 0.44 for SenD and 0.39 for normal training.

T1.justification: Definitions 3.1–3.4, Lemma 1, Proposition 1, the complexity analysis and the mathematical derivations in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion make identical claims about hallucination oscillations, SenD, EES efficiency, factuality and downstream performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations connecting SEIs to uncertainty, the discussion of combining SenD with RAG, and the continual-training and computational limitations in Section 6 are identical.

D1.justification: Both disclose the same hyperparameters, frozen-layer counts, training-time measurements and code/data repository link. No implementation or reproducibility information changes.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference list and positioning relative to earlier research are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv identification changes from v4 dated 16 Jul 2025 to v5 dated 6 Oct 2025, with the corresponding version link and metadata updated. Body prose, headings and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, algorithm boxes, captions and their placement are identical. Pages 2–17 render identically; the first-page difference is confined to the version/date stamp text.

improvement.justification: The main text and Appendices A–E retain identical methods, evidence, derivations, interpretations and presentation. Updating the arXiv version/date identification does not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
